method.label: Locate polar roots and pair them

annotationRationale: Polar powers locate the twelve cyclic roots and identify those in the right half-plane. Complex addition cancels paired imaginary parts, and special-angle cosine values evaluate the sum.
sourceMethod: Followed the official circle-of-roots and conjugate-pair summation method. Derived the full root formula explicitly, correcting the source's inaccurate principal-root label.

review.mathCheck: The distinct roots are √2(cos(kπ/6)+i sin(kπ/6)), k=0,…,11. Positive real part selects k=0,1,2,10,11; the imaginary-axis roots are excluded. Conjugate pairing gives √2+√6+√2=2√2+√6, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded adaptation of official solution #12's circular root arrangement and conjugate-pair sum. The official page incorrectly calls the π/6 root principal; the candidate avoids that mislabel and correctly derives all twelve roots.
review.annotationCheck: The root enumeration, boundary exclusions, cancellation, and special-angle evaluation are reconstructible at AMC 12 level.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The accepted CN links cover complex addition and special-angle values as background. Neither assessed complex-root node has a supplied CN alignment.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: N-CN.B.4/B.5 provide partial polar-form and power coverage; N-CN.A.2 and F-TF.A.3 support the computations. These links do not fully cover cyclic complex roots.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: Both assessed nodes fit locating the cyclic roots. cnm_h100 and cnm_277 appropriately supply addition and special-angle background.
